reviews.x: I like them, the seller gives you a lot & quite useable & they aren't labeled but you just go with the flow of the brush that beat suits the makeup you are applying c: the brush part is soft & thick & did I mention there's a lot. They seem to apply great & blend well c:

These brushes are okay. But for what I paid they're okay. The spoolie brush tip, like with the metal cap, it all fell off, and many of the others are loose. I bought them to use for about a month until I picked out brushes for a full set. Overall they were okay, they didn't last long, and many of these brushes i didn't even know what they were.

reviews.t: Nice set for what I paid
reviews.x: Nice set for what I paid, came in a very nice  fold over pouch that snaps shut easily, the brushes stay snug n fit which I really liked, they do not slide out even after opened, all brushes are labeled in easy to read print and bristles covered. Every tool you need is in this set, not one missing !
I'm in love with these brushes!!! I would say these brushes are for beginners with eyes and eyebrows, they are super soft and I love to use them.

These are a nice set of brushes for the price. Keep in mind you are getting what you pay for them. They are just a nice inexpensive set that you can use for what I call the dirty work that you don't want to use your good brushes for.

For how cheap this is, you'd think it would be crappy. But it's actually the exact opposite! This brush set is absolutely amazing! The brushes are soft, and blend perfectly! Would definitely recommend to a friend...

reviews.t: Very disappointed, but they are very soft
reviews.x: In my brush set, I didn't get a package for them, and they didn't have labels on them. Very disappointed, but they are very soft. I guess you get what you pay for.

reviews.t: You get what you pay for, no more, no less
reviews.x: These brush handles are very light and cheap and hot water will make the glue come loose and the handle will fall way from the brush head, but its an easy fix. The bristles are very soft and are medium quality. I use the double sided brushes in my travel kit. I don't use much of them for daily use just because the types of brushes arnt really what I need for my routine. They are an even cheaper quality than brushes you would get at Claire's. But you get a lot for the price and I can't complain.

I love these brushes! They work wonderfully and they're useful for so many things. I use the thicker ones for my face makeup and the thinner ones for eye application. They're very well made and I've had them for a few months now (with multiple washes). I would 100% recommend!
I don't like these for my powder eyeshadow,but with my cream shadows they are awesome!
Cute color but very stiff dont waste your mula

I am a huge makeup fanatic, wear it everyday and from time to time I do others makeup for events and brushes are always my go to when restocking on products! These brushes are amazing and will definitely buy more of! The quality is great, they’re sturdy and soft to the touch, blend and cut creases to perfection than any other expensive brand brush I own. If you’re looking to buy affordable but top quality brush set then this is the right set for you, even if you’re just experimenting with makeup
They weren't the best brushes ever but for the price they did their job! Their nice and soft and there are so many different brushes!
The came before they were supposed to, like a week before. They are awesome brushes for lips, eye liner, and eye shadow!
High quality brushes, and super cheap price. There are also double sided ones. love love love it!!!
I use these brushes everyday and I absolutely love them definitely recommend them
Came earlier then expected and I love it!

They arrived a little late, but it's to be somewhat of expected coming from China. I just used them today first time and I'm in love with them. Very nice brushes and different type of brushes, so you can do the works with your makeup. Best investment for makeup brushes, the quality is good and it won't break the bank. Would definitely purchase agin.

reviews.t: and some of them are useful. Several of the brushes are repeats
reviews.x: The brushes were much smaller than I anticipated. They are cute, and some of them are useful. Several of the brushes are repeats, and I think there could be a little more quality over quantity. I am pleased over all, but I would only use about half of them.

My niece is a MUA and she needed some new brushes for her upcoming projects, I wanted to help out with her spending cost and get these for her as a nice gift, SHE LOVES THEM says they are perfect and help her apply make up better than before ! Great buy !

Over all the brushes are quite nice.They have a angled brush in this set it helps blend your eyeshadow very well and I love it.But I was disappointed in one of the brushes I was looking forward to witch was the biggest one it's a flat brush not very big.

reviews.t: but dense enough too hold your makeup and blend it nicely. Unlike other brushes that I've ordered from amazon
reviews.x: Very soft, but dense enough too hold your makeup and blend it nicely. Unlike other brushes that I've ordered from amazon, which are to soft to apply make up properly. For such a cheap price, I was pleasantly surprised by the quality!

reviews.t: Not worth it. Go for the quality.
reviews.x: These brushes fell apart after the first wash. They aren’t soft and don’t disperse product well. I bought these and within a month had to throw away almost all of them. I’d rather save up to buy quality brushes.

reviews.t: Definitely a great buy so cheap
reviews.x: Definitely a great buy so cheap. I wish I knew what half the brushes were used for then I would be able to use them. It would be nice if they came with a booklet or sheet of what the brushes are and used for.
The bristles feel a little rough. I am a beginner with makeup, I've never really worn much of it so i figured i would get this brush set because its cheap. It does the job. I would recommend.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the brushes soft and good at blending, especially for the price.
Several reviewers say the set is a good value for the low price, though some note you get what you pay for.
Some reviewers report durability problems, such as loose or falling-off brush tips and handles separating from the brush head.
A few reviewers mention labeling inconsistencies, with some sets labeled and others not.
Some reviewers find the brushes stiff or not ideal for certain uses like powder eyeshadow.
